scenes.text: Emergency in Korea. Which number do you call for an ambulance? Answer before the timer ends.
scenes.q: Which number calls an ambulance in Korea?

scenes.text: One one nine, for fire and ambulance. Police is one one two. And for tourist help in English, call one three three zero.
scenes.why: 119 fire and ambulance. 112 police. 1330 tourist help in English.
